texts.name: 1. Build exactly the 15 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links. 2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in screen order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions. 3. The brand primary color and the typeface in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself (neutrals, text, surfaces, success / error / disabled, sale and rating colors), plus type scale, spacing, radii and elevation, and apply them consistently. 4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button, a default Text Field and the platform shell (status bar, home indicator). Design all other states, the headers, the main navigation and every business component as reusable components in your file. 5. Use the logo, product photos, banners, payment logos and icons from 04 · Media. A product marked “no photo supplied” needs a consistent fallback of your choice. 6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
texts.text:
1. Build exactly the 15 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links.
2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in screen order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions.
3. The brand primary color and the typeface in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself (neutrals, text, surfaces, success / error / disabled, sale and rating colors), plus type scale, spacing, radii and elevation, and apply them consistently.
4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button, a default Text Field and the platform shell (status bar, home indicator). Design all other states, the headers, the main navigation and every business component as reusable components in your file.
5. Use the logo, product photos, banners, payment logos and icons from 04 · Media. A product marked “no photo supplied” needs a consistent fallback of your choice.
6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
